summary: Iteration 23 — Auto-try user's saved PAN for encrypted PDFs + Credit Card statement support. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed on public URL. New tests cover: (1) POST /api/gmail/parse-attachment with real encrypted Zerodha Capital Gain PDF (19d96681abe47ab8) + NO PAN on user → returns {success:false, password_required:true, tried_your_pan:false, message contains 'CAS / credit card / Zerodha'}. (2) Same endpoint with WRONG 10-char PAN (ABCDE1234F) written to user doc → returns {success:false, password_required:true, tried_your_pan:true, message starts with "We tried your saved PAN but it didn't work"}. Also cleaned up pan_number field after test run. (3) Source-level: pdf_attachment_parser.py GPT-5.2 prompt contains 'credit_card_statement' enum + credit_card object with all required fields (issuer, card_number_last4, statement_date, due_date, total_due, min_due, credit_limit, available_credit, reward_points, purchases_debits, payments_credits). (4) Unit-tested cas_to_questionnaire_updates() for CC mapping: credit_limit→has_credit_card+credit_card_limit, total_due→credit_card_outstanding, purchases_debits→monthly_credit_card_spend. Empty CC object produces NO CC keys. (5) Source-level: /api/gmail/emails query has '"card statement"', '"payment due"', 'subject:bill' + senders 'sbicard.com', 'americanexpress', 'hdfcbank.net', 'axisbank.com'. looks_like_cas heuristic includes 'credit', 'card', 'bill'. (6) Regression: /api/gmail/status (200), /api/gmail/scan-and-apply-all (200), /api/documents/auto-apply (not 404), /api/reports/peer-comparison (200), /api/transactions/subscriptions (200), parse-attachment body validation (400). Frontend: /arthvyay/smart-import loads cleanly post login with all 3 tabs (Policy Upload, Email Parsing, Gmail Connect). Conditional UI in SmartImport.js L878-886 verified by source inspection — when attachmentModal.tried_your_pan is true it renders 'We tried your saved PAN — didn't work.'; otherwise 'Common password formats:'. The tried_your_pan flag is correctly propagated from the backend response (L60) into the modal state.

action_items: None — all features in review_request verified and working.

(Nice-to-have) Consider deduplicating the Gmail search query: /api/gmail/emails inline query (routes/gmail.py L209-219) and services/gmail_auto_scan.py FINANCIAL_SEARCH_QUERY now BOTH need the new CC terms. Only /emails has the new CC senders (sbicard/americanexpress/hdfcbank.net/axisbank.com); gmail_auto_scan.py should be kept in sync or extracted to a shared constant to avoid drift (already flagged in iter-22).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/gmail.py L320-334 (auto-PAN logic): the ValueError catch sets auto_tried=True but also swallows the PAN-incorrect error — this is intentional (we want to continue and surface password_required). Verified behavior is correct.

services/pdf_attachment_parser.py L209: 'updates["credit_card_limit"] = credit_limit' always overwrites on each run — comment says 'Take the highest credit limit seen across statements' but code actually takes the LAST seen. For users with multiple cards/statements uploaded sequentially, the final card processed wins. Consider Math.max() against existing questionnaire value, OR storing a per-card array. Non-blocking for MVP but a real semantic mismatch with the comment.
routes/gmail.py parse-attachment does not limit PDF size before downloading/parsing — re-flag from iter-22. A malicious 50MB CC statement attachment will hit GPT-5.2 token limits and memory.

services/pdf_attachment_parser.py L138-140: prompt instructs GPT to emit credit card purchases with category='inferred' — the resulting transactions[] is fed to apply_parsed_data() which writes to db.transactions. No dedup mechanism if user re-parses the same CC statement → duplicate transaction rows. Consider hashing (user_id, date, amount, description) to idempotently insert.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 pytest, real Gmail + real encrypted Zerodha PDF)
